player_points#pp-bucket-mixing.detail: This is a split of fix versus evidence limitation, not a relabel. FIX (done): KXNBABENCHPTS is out of player_points; stage s7, bench interactions, bench inputs (team bench model, starter ledger, combo_component_marginals) and bench text are gone from that record; game_overtime_and_team_events carries the bench model, ledger, stage s4, interaction, dataset and gap u8; benchmark inputs are context; nba.starters_pit is attached; the team-reading assertions are removed from mechanism summary, target, stage names, provenance (verified false), reclass and resolution texts. EVIDENCE LIMITATION (not fixed, carried elsewhere): the entity of KXNBABENCHPTS (a team's bench total or a named player as a bench player) is unverified because no market is listed and BASKETBALLENTITYSTAT.pdf (also the player-prop terms file) is unreadable; it is declared and classified UNVERIFIABLE_CONTRACT in game_overtime_and_team_events#u8, and the series would return to player_points if a player-level reading is shown.
